name: HighPoint Trades — Job Status Monitor & Multi-Channel Notifications

nodes.name: Trigger_GoogleSheets_Poll
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Poll Google Sheets JobTracker tab every 2 minutes for new or changed rows.
INPUT: Google Sheets rows with CSV job fields.
OUTPUT: One item per detected row change.
CONFIG: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your actual Sheet ID. Sheet must have headers: JobID, CustomerName, CustomerEmail, JobType, Priority, CurrentStatus, InstallationZipCode, PreviousStatus.
ERRORS: 403 = re-authenticate Google Sheets OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Code_ValidateAndNormalize_Input
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Validate all job records, detect status changes, apply digest cache, detect missing emails.
INPUT: Raw Google Sheets row data.
OUTPUT: Normalized job objects with routing flags. Duplicates and unchanged statuses are dropped.
CONFIG: DIGEST_TTL_MS = 300000 (5 min). Fallback zip = 90210.
ERRORS: Empty return = all rows were duplicates or had no status change.

nodes.name: IF_MissingEmail_Check
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Route records with missing customer email to error logging branch.
INPUT: Normalized job record with has_missing_email flag.
OUTPUT: TRUE = missing email (error path), FALSE = email present (main flow).
CONFIG: No config required.
ERRORS: N/A

matchingColumns: Timestamp	ErrorType	AffectedJobID	Details	Resolution	NotifiedManager	DateResolved

schema.id: Timestamp	ErrorType	AffectedJobID	Details	Resolution	NotifiedManager	DateResolved
schema.displayName: Timestamp	ErrorType	AffectedJobID	Details	Resolution	NotifiedManager	DateResolved

nodes.name: Log_Issues_MissingEmail
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Log missing email error to Issues tab.
INPUT: Error log record from Code_PrepareLog_MissingEmail.
OUTPUT: Appended row in Issues sheet.
CONFIG: Sheet must have Issues tab with columns: Timestamp, ErrorType, AffectedJobID, Details, Resolution, NotifiedManager, DateResolved.
ERRORS: 403 = re-authenticate.

nodes.name: Slack_Alert_MissingEmail
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Alert Operations Manager in #alerts channel when a customer email is missing.
INPUT: Log record with job details.
OUTPUT: Slack message in #alerts.
CONFIG: Slack credential must have post permissions to #alerts channel.
ERRORS: 403 = re-authorize Slack. 404 = channel name wrong.

nodes.name: IF_StatusIsScheduled_WeatherCheck
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Only run weather API for Scheduled jobs. All other statuses bypass weather entirely.
INPUT: Normalized job record.
OUTPUT: TRUE = Scheduled (go to weather check), FALSE = not Scheduled (go directly to priority routing).
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: Code_CheckWeatherCache_3hrTTL
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Check 3-hour weather cache before hitting OpenWeatherMap API. Reduces API calls and prevents rate limiting.
INPUT: Job record with effective_zip.
OUTPUT: Same record with cache status flags. If cache hit, rainProbability is pre-populated.
CONFIG: WEATHER_CACHE_TTL_MS = 10800000 (3 hours).
ERRORS: N/A — cache miss simply sends to API node.

nodes.name: IF_WeatherCacheHit_SkipAPI
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: If weather data is cached and fresh, skip API call entirely.
INPUT: Job record with weather_cache_hit flag.
OUTPUT: TRUE = use cached data (skip to rain decision), FALSE = call API.
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: API_OpenWeatherMap_RainCheck
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Fetch 24-hour rain forecast from OpenWeatherMap for the job zip code.
INPUT: Job record with effective_zip and WEATHER_API_KEY env var.
OUTPUT: OpenWeatherMap forecast JSON. On failure, continueOnFail passes error downstream.
CONFIG: Set WEATHER_API_KEY environment variable in n8n. cnt=8 returns 8 x 3-hour windows (24 hours).
ERRORS: 401 = invalid API key. 404 = zip not found (Error Type 3). 429 = rate limit (Error Type 5). Timeout = Error Type 2.

nodes.name: Code_ParseWeather_RainProbability
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Parse OpenWeatherMap response, extract max rain probability for next 24 hours, detect all error types, update weather cache.
INPUT: Raw API response (or error object from continueOnFail).
OUTPUT: Job record enriched with weather_rainProbability (0-100), weather_api_error flag, error details.
CONFIG: Rain probability >60 triggers delay branch. Fallback = 50% (conservative).
ERRORS: All handled internally — error flags trigger downstream error logging nodes.

nodes.name: IF_WeatherAPIError_LogAndContinue
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Detect weather API errors and route to error logging. Execution CONTINUES after logging (non-blocking).
INPUT: Parsed weather record with weather_api_error flag.
OUTPUT: TRUE = API error (log + continue), FALSE = clean data (proceed to rain decision).
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

schema.id: Timestamp	ErrorType	AffectedJobID	Details	Resolution	NotifiedManager	DateResolved
schema.displayName: Timestamp	ErrorType	AffectedJobID	Details	Resolution	NotifiedManager	DateResolved

nodes.name: Switch_WeatherRisk_Scheduled
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Route to Delay Warning branch if rain >60%, Clear Weather branch otherwise.
INPUT: Job record with weather_rainProbability (0-100).
OUTPUT: output[0] = rain >60% (delay branch), output[1] = fallback (clear weather branch).
CONFIG: Threshold = 60%. Adjust here if business requires different threshold.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: Switch_Priority_NonScheduled
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: For non-Scheduled jobs, route Urgent to Email+Slack, Standard to Email only.
INPUT: Normalized job record with csv_priority.
OUTPUT: output[0] = Urgent, output[1] = Standard (fallback).
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: Slack_CrewAlert_Urgent_NonScheduled
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Send Slack webhook alert for Urgent non-Scheduled jobs. Uses SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env var.
INPUT: Job record with csv_priority=Urgent.
OUTPUT: Slack message in #field-crew-alerts.
CONFIG: Set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable. retry=3, delay=2s.
ERRORS: continueOnFail + retry logic covers Error Type 4 (webhook failure).

nodes.name: IF_SlackFailed_NonScheduled
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Detect Slack webhook failure after all retries. Routes to error logging if failed.
INPUT: HTTP response from Slack webhook.
OUTPUT: TRUE = failure (log it), FALSE = success.
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: Switch_Priority_RainDelay
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Route rain delay jobs by priority. Urgent gets Email+Slack Delay Alert, Standard gets Email only.
INPUT: Job record with rain >60% and Scheduled status.
OUTPUT: output[0] = Urgent delay, output[1] = Standard delay.
CONFIG: None.
ERRORS: N/A

nodes.name: Wait_RateLimit_WeatherAPI
nodes.notes:
PURPOSE: Enforce 1-second delay between sequential weather API calls to prevent hitting the 60 req/min rate limit.
INPUT: Job record about to hit the weather API.
OUTPUT: Same record after 1-second pause.
CONFIG: Adjust amount for stricter rate limiting if needed.
ERRORS: N/A
